notes: Page fetched via web reader; publishedTime 2025-06-17T16:00:00+00:00, page header 'Jun 17, 2025'. This is the 2.5 Flash + 2.5 Pro GA and 2.5 Flash-Lite preview announcement (2.5 Flash first previewed at I/O 2025-05-20; that earlier preview post is not merged here — GA date taken as this release per assignment). PROSE NAMES NO BENCHMARK and prints no score: the only evaluation artifact is the GIF table gemini_2-5_benchmarks_margin_light2x_1.gif (columns: Flash-Lite Preview 06-17 non-thinking/thinking, Flash non-thinking/thinking, Pro thinking), so all 14 rows were pending per goal.md §12.5; the 2026-09-01 reader pass transcribed every cell of the archived GIF and all 14 rows are now verified. Rows record the Flash Thinking column; every row's notes carry Flash non-thinking and Flash-Lite values for the same benchmark. Pro column values belong to the GA moment of 2.5 Pro and are kept in notes, not separate rows. Table footnote (visually read) explicitly states: Gemini scores are pass@1 single-attempt via AI Studio API with default sampling, multiple-attempts SWE-bench uses Google scaffolding with model-self re-scoring, Aider = 3-trial average with non-default settings, Vibe-Eval judged by Gemini, and external numbers sourced from leaderboards (agi.safe.ai, scale.com, livecodebench.github.io, aider.chat, kaggle FACTS).
